tonight.headline: Two starters in doubt; the lineup is already the projection
body: Bad news first. Garrett Wilson entered the concussion protocol today (ESPN, 17:53Z), and Bhayshul Tuten sat out every practice this week and is a game-time decision for Thursday at Baltimore. Etienne's practice window did not open, so he holds a bench seat at zero for another week.

As set AVIATO project 125.7 against Talla Metralla's 130.1 — exactly the projection lineup. The owner swapped the Commanders D/ST for the Giants at 20:18Z, and Philadelphia then benched McKee for Joe Milton III. Two checks remain: Tuten at Thursday 17:45, Wilson at Sunday 10:30.

case.label: Where the points are
case.body: ESPN gives AVIATO 48%. Nothing on the bench beats a starter by more than a coin flip, so the 4.4-point gap is roster, not lineup.

case.label: Their week
case.body: Talla Metralla start Burrow in Madrid (08:30 CDMX Sunday) and Derrick Henry Thursday against your Jaguars-facing Ravens, who start undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano (ESPN 4 Nov). Kelce was limited Wednesday with an ankle, called maintenance (AtoZ 4 Nov); Mike Evans, on their bench, did not practise (RotoWire 4 Nov).

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The projection lineup is set, both contingencies resolve as written, and AVIATO still trail by more than 10 after Sunday's early games — then the gap was roster, not lineup.

case.body: Concussion protocol, day-to-day (Aaron Glenn via ESPN, 4 Nov 17:53Z). He took the hit on the second-to-last play against Las Vegas and reported symptoms Monday. A concussed player must be cleared by an independent doctor, so the Friday report and Sunday's inactives are the evidence.

case.body: Rising in the waiver tool (16.5 opportunities in his last week) and the 49ers' No. 2 back; ran well but with receiving concerns (Fantasy Nerds 26 Oct).

case.label: The news
case.body: Christian McCaffrey DNP Wednesday with a hamstring (49ers report via Heavy, 4 Nov). San Francisco host Las Vegas as 9.5-point favourites (Fox Sports/bet365 3 Nov).

case.label: Why not now
case.body: A free agent, so it costs nothing to wait: AVIATO's only open seat is Etienne's, and that claim was made today. Kamara and Allgeier already cover the Tuten and Wilson checks.

case.label: When to act
case.body: McCaffrey ruled out on Friday's report and Tuten inactive Thursday — then add Black as a free agent for Etienne.
